sentences.en: This would be terrible.

sentences.en: It's going to destroy the judge's life even more.
sentences.zh: 这是关于在不为政治目的强行推进的情况下找到前进的道路。

sentences.en: Chris Coons and the Democrats are trying to coax him along, saying, look, you know, this is what the Senate is about.
sentences.zh: 正如向我们描述的那样，气氛变得非常紧张。

sentences.en: It's about compromise.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生时，弗莱克参议员变得更加焦虑，他是否要反悔，并基本上对几分钟前似乎

sentences.en: It's about finding a way forward without jamming something through for political purposes.
sentences.zh: 已经是板上钉钉的事踩下刹车？

sentences.en: It got very heated, as it was described to us.
sentences.zh: 那么弗莱克是如何决定继续前进的呢？

sentences.en: And all of it, with Senator Flake becoming even more anxious, was he going to reverse himself and essentially put the brakes on what had seemed just moments before
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时刻，他提出了一个担忧：这甚至是 FBI 能做的事情吗？

sentences.en: to be a kind of foregone conclusion?
sentences.zh: 这对 FBI 来说会有价值吗？

sentences.en: And so how does Flake decide to move forward?
sentences.zh: 那么弗莱克决定如何继续推进呢？

sentences.en: So at one point, he raises the concern of, is this something that the FBI could even do?
sentences.zh: 所以有一段时间，他提出过这样一个担忧：这真的是联邦调查局能做的事吗？

sentences.en: Is this something that would be valuable to the FBI?
sentences.zh: 这对联邦调查局来说会有价值吗？

sentences.en: Do they have the resources?
sentences.zh: 他们有资源吗？

sentences.en: Do they have the wherewithal?
sentences.zh: 他们有资金和能力吗？

sentences.en: So somebody suggests calling Christopher Wray, the FBI director.
sentences.zh: 于是有人建议打电话给联邦调查局局长克里斯托弗·雷。

sentences.en: They try that.
sentences.zh: 他们照做了。

sentences.en: They can't find Christopher Wray.
sentences.zh: 他们找不到克里斯托弗·雷。

sentences.en: They can't reach him.
sentences.zh: 他们联系不上他。

sentences.en: And so the second choice is to call Rod Rosenstein.
sentences.zh: 所以第二个选择是打电话给罗德·罗森斯坦。

sentences.en: It comes down to, you know, a phone call with the very man who the president might yet fire and was actively considering firing.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，你知道的，这通电话是打给那个总统随时可能解雇、且一直在积极考虑解雇的人。

sentences.en: That's a phone call that obviously needs to be done with some privacy.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一通需要在一个私密环境中进行的电话。

sentences.en: So Chris Coons and Jeff Flake cram themselves into one of these old-fashioned kind of oversized phone booths, closed the door,
sentences.zh: 因此，克里斯·库恩斯和杰夫·弗莱克挤进了一个老式的超大号电话亭里，关上门，

sentences.en: took out a cell phone and essentially put it on speaker and called Rosenstein.
sentences.zh: 掏出手机，基本上开了免提，然后打给了罗森斯坦。

sentences.en: We are told that Mr. Rosenstein does reassure Senator Flake that the FBI can do an investigation, though he does say that given the scope of it, relatively short amount of time,
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，罗森斯坦先生确实向弗莱克参议员保证联邦调查局可以进行调查，不过他也表示，鉴于调查范围以及相对较短的时间，

sentences.en: less than a week, that it's unlikely to produce a lot more than senators already know.
sentences.zh: 不到一周，这不太可能查出比参议员们已经知道的更多内容。

sentences.en: But he says, yes, we can do that.
sentences.zh: 但他确实说，可以，我们可以做到。

sentences.en: So with this green light from Rosenstein, what does Senator Flake do?
sentences.zh: 因此，有了罗森斯坦的开绿灯，弗莱克参议员会怎么做呢？

sentences.en: Senator Flake does one last thing before he comes back into the hearing room, and that is that he takes out his phone and he calls two of his Republican colleagues
sentences.zh: 弗莱克参议员在回到听证会现场之前做了最后一件事情，那就是他掏出手机，打电话给他的另外两位共和党同僚

sentences.en: who are not members of the Senate Judiciary Committee, and that is Senator Susan Collins of Maine and Senator Lisa Murkowski of Alaska.
sentences.zh: 他们不是参议院司法委员会的成员，分别是来自缅因州的参议员苏珊·柯林斯和来自阿拉斯加的参议员莉萨·穆尔科斯基。

sentences.en: He called the two of them and basically said, are you guys with me?
sentences.zh: 他打电话给这两人，基本上说，你们支持我吗？

sentences.en: Both assured Senator Flake that, yes, they would back him and that they would demand the same thing, a one-week delay and an FBI investigation.
sentences.zh: 两人都向弗莱克参议员保证，是的，她们会支持他，并且她们也会提出同样的要求，即推迟一周并展开联邦调查局调查。

sentences.en: And armed with that, Senator Flake went back into the committee room knowing that the Senate Republicans and President Trump would have to relent because if they didn't,
sentences.zh: 带着这些，弗莱克参议员回到了委员会会议室，他知道参议院共和党人和特朗普总统将不得不做出妥协，因为如果他们不这样做，

sentences.en: they wouldn't have the votes ultimately to confirm Judge Kavanaugh without the three Republicans.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这三位共和党人的支持，他们最终将没有足够的票数来确认卡瓦诺法官的提名。

sentences.en: As a point of personal privilege, I'm going to call on Senator Flake to speak.
sentences.zh: 作为一个特权问题，我要请弗莱克参议员发言。

sentences.en: Normally we would start to vote right now, but as a point of personal privilege, I would call on Senator Flake.
sentences.zh: 通常我们现在就要开始投票了，但作为一个特权问题，我要请弗莱克参议员发言。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: It all happens very quickly.
sentences.zh: 这一切发生得非常快。

sentences.en: And even for veteran watchers of the legislative sausage-making process, it was quite messy.
sentences.zh: 即便是对于立法香肠制作过程的资深观察家来说，这也相当混乱。

sentences.en: I have been speaking with a number of people on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我一直在与对方阵营的许多人进行交谈。

sentences.en: We've had conversations ongoing for a while with regard to making sure that we do due diligence here.
sentences.zh: 为了确保我们在这里进行了尽职调查，我们已经进行了好一阵子的对话。

sentences.en: Senator Flake announced his decision.
sentences.zh: 弗莱克参议员宣布了他的决定。

sentences.en: And I think it would be proper to delay the floor vote for up to but not more than one week.
sentences.zh: 我认为推迟全院投票是适当的，时间最长不超过一周。

sentences.en: He said that he had changed his mind and that now believed that he would be willing to vote for Judge Kavanaugh's nomination
sentences.zh: 他说他改变了主意，现在相信自己愿意投票支持卡瓦诺法官的提名

sentences.en: to move forward from the committee to the full Senate, but only with the assurance that this one-week delay would happen.
sentences.zh: 从委员会移交给参议院全院，但前提是必须保证推迟这一周时间。

sentences.en: So that's, with that agreement, I will vote to advance Bill to the floor.
sentences.zh: 所以，基于这一协议，我将投票支持将法案提交全院。

sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺法官的提名已经获得委员会的批准并提交给了参议院全院。

sentences.zh: 迈克，你怎么看杰夫·弗莱克周五的所作所为？

sentences.zh: 我不禁回想起我们刚开始交谈时你对他的评价。

sentences.en: He's sort of despondent at the state of the divided country.
sentences.zh: 他对国家分裂的现状感到有些沮丧绝望。

sentences.en: He's distraught over the state of the U.S.

sentences.en: Senate.

sentences.zh: 再过几个月他就要卸任了。

sentences.en: And then this moment, this huge decision comes before him in a way where he is so decisive.
sentences.zh: 然后在这个时刻，这个重大决定摆在他面前，而他的决定具有如此决定性的作用。

sentences.en: My sense of him is that he wasn't at peace with the initial decision.
sentences.zh: 我对他的感觉是，他对最初的决定并不安心。

sentences.en: You could sort of see that in his face even before all of the kind of machinations behind the scenes took place.

sentences.en: You could see looking at him that he didn't look at peace.
sentences.zh: 看着他，你能看出他内心并不平静。

sentences.en: It's unclear to me whether it will turn out that Senator Flake will go down in history, you know, feeling like this is the sort of most heroic moment in his Senate career, because

sentences.en: And so I don't know what he will think about this in the end.

sentences.en: But at least for the moment, you could see on his face at the end of that hearing, after

sentences.zh: 周六，特朗普总统在动身前往西弗吉尼亚州参加集会时表示，他将对

sentences.zh: 我感到无比愤怒，因为司法委员会的所有这些男人基本上强迫一个女人讲述她一生中最具创伤性的经历，然后

sentences.zh: 我明白，这是全国各地女性的痛苦和愤怒，她们无法相信今天仍在发生这种事。

sentences.en: Ana Maria Archila was one of the two women who followed Senator Flake out of his office on Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 安娜·玛丽亚·阿奇拉是周五上午尾随弗莱克参议员离开办公室的两名女性之一。

sentences.en: I had been protesting alongside hundreds of people who had been coming to Washington,
sentences.zh: 我一直在与数百名来到华盛顿特区抗议的人一起抗议，

sentences.en: D.C.
sentences.zh: 特区。

sentences.en: for weeks.
sentences.zh: 已经持续好几周了。

sentences.en: We were there to protest the nomination of Brett Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 我们去那里是为了抗议对布雷特·卡瓦诺的提名。

sentences.en: But on Monday of this week, I went to Senator Flake's office and for the first time told my story as a survivor of sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 但在本周一，我去了弗莱克参议员的办公室，第一次讲述了我作为性虐待幸存者的故事。

sentences.en: And so on Friday, I went back to his office to see if I could talk to him.
sentences.zh: 所以在周五，我又去了他的办公室，看看能不能跟他说说话。

sentences.en: I had just met a young woman, Maria Gallagher, a few minutes before, and she was there for the first time.
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟前，我刚认识了一个年轻女孩玛丽亚·加拉格尔，她是第一次来这里。

sentences.en: She had never talked to any elected officials.
sentences.zh: 她从未与任何民选官员交谈过。

sentences.en: She had never told her story, but she felt compelled to be there with the people that had been protesting.
sentences.zh: 她从未讲述过自己的故事，但她觉得有必要和抗议的人们呆在一起。

sentences.en: And so together, we went to Senator Flake's office, hoping that maybe we could catch him and talk to him and tell him our stories.
sentences.zh: 于是我们一起去了弗莱克参议员的办公室，希望能碰碰运气跟他谈谈，把我们的故事告诉他。

sentences.en: Right before we saw him walk into the elevator, we saw the statement that came out of his office that said that he was ready to support Brett Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 就在我们看到他走进电梯之前，我们看到了他办公室发表的声明，称他准备支持布雷特·卡瓦诺。

sentences.en: And then right after he walked out of his office, this group of reporters that had been standing
sentences.zh: 就在他走办公室后，这群一直在旁边等待的记者，

sentences.en: by, like, ran behind him and we ran behind them and inserted ourselves in that elevator.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，跟在他身后跑，我们也跟在他们后面跑，挤进了那个电梯。

sentences.en: And what are you thinking when you actually find yourself with this one opportunity to speak to Senator Flake?
sentences.zh: 当你发现自己真正拥有这个唯一的机会与弗莱克参议员对话时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: It's sort of extraordinary luck.
sentences.zh: 这简直是种非凡的运气。

sentences.en: Are you conscious of that in that moment?
sentences.zh: 在那一刻你意识到这一点了吗？

sentences.en: I am conscious of the urgency of not letting him get away.
sentences.zh: 我意识到绝不能让他逃掉的紧迫性。

sentences.en: On Monday, I stood in front of your office with Adi Barkan.
sentences.zh: 周一，我带着阿迪·巴尔坎站在你的办公室前。

sentences.en: I told the story of my sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 我讲述了我遭受性侵的故事。

sentences.en: I'm conscious of the fact that this is the moment that he might, for the first time, understand the pain that women are feeling.
sentences.zh: 我意识到这是他可能第一次理解女性所感受到的痛苦的时刻。

sentences.en: They will have to have, who has been accused of violating a young girl?
sentences.zh: 他们必须拥有，谁被指控侵犯了一个年轻女孩？

sentences.en: What are you doing, sir?
sentences.zh: 先生，你在做什么？

sentences.en: He kept saying, thank you.
sentences.zh: 他一直在说，谢谢。

sentences.en: I have to go.
sentences.zh: 我得走了。

sentences.en: He kept pressing the button in the elevator to try to close the door.
sentences.zh: 他不停地按着电梯里的按钮，试图关上门。

sentences.en: And he, I think, really wanted that to end.
sentences.zh: 我想他是真的很想让这一切结束。

sentences.en: And at that moment, Maria Gallagher jumped in and said, they don't matter, that they should just stay quiet because if they tell you what happened
sentences.zh: 就在那时，玛丽亚·加拉格尔冲了进来，说他们并不重要，他们应该保持安静，因为如果他们告诉你发生了什么

sentences.en: to them, you're going to ignore them.
sentences.zh: 对他们而言，你会忽视他们。

sentences.en: That's what happened to me.
sentences.zh: 这就是发生在我身上的事。

sentences.en: And that's what you're telling all women in America, that they don't matter.
sentences.zh: 这也是你在告诉美国的所有女性，她们并不重要。

sentences.en: They should just keep it to themselves because if they have told the truth, you're just going to help that man to power anyway.
sentences.zh: 她们应该把事情藏在心里，因为如果她们说的是实话，你反正也会帮那个男人夺取权力。

sentences.en: And I think her voice and the pain in her voice was so intense, he could not look at her.
sentences.zh: 我想她的声音以及声音里的痛苦是如此强烈，以至于他无法直视她。

sentences.en: It was in that moment that she said, look at me, look at me, look at me, that you'll let
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，她说，看着我，看着我，看着我，而你却让

sentences.en: people like that go into the highest court of the land and tell everyone what they can do to their bodies.
sentences.zh: 这样的人进入国家最高法院，并告诉所有人他们可以对自己的身体做什么。

sentences.en: In some ways, like the essence of this moment is that phrase, look at me, do not look away.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这一刻的精髓就是这句话：看着我，不要移开视线。

sentences.en: Look at me and tell me that my story doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 看着我，告诉我我的故事并不重要。

sentences.en: Tell me that you are okay sending that message to women across the country, that our stories do not matter.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，你愿意把这个信息传达给全国各地的女性，告诉她们我们的故事并不重要。

sentences.en: You have an opportunity to tell me a different thing, which is that, yes, your story, your experience matters.
sentences.zh: 你有一个机会告诉我另一件事，那就是，是的，你的故事，你的经历很重要。

sentences.en: And I think that's what we were trying to do in that moment in that elevator.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们在那个电梯里的那一刻努力想做的事情。

sentences.en: I think he initially, you know, tried to escape kind of faSt.
sentences.zh: 我想他最初，你知道的，试图快点逃跑。

sentences.en: And then I could see in his demeanor and his body that it was sinking in, that he could not
sentences.zh: 然后我从他的神态和身体语言中看出，他逐渐意识到了，他无法

sentences.en: escape the emotion and that he could not escape the connection that we demanded from him.
sentences.zh: 逃避这种情绪，也无法逃避我们向他要求的这种连接。

sentences.en: You are allowing someone who is unwilling to take responsibility for his own action in the higher court of the country and to have the role of repairing the harm that has been done
sentences.zh: 你正允许一个不愿意为自己的行为承担责任的人进入国家最高法院，并让他承担修复在这个国家里

sentences.en: in this country to many people.
sentences.zh: 对许多人造成的伤害的角色。

sentences.en: No, no, thank you.
sentences.zh: 不，不，谢谢。

sentences.en: Senator, do you care to respond?
sentences.zh: 参议员，您想回应一下吗？

sentences.en: And what exactly told you that, that it was sinking in?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么让你觉得，他已经意识到这一点了？

sentences.en: No, I want to talk to him.
sentences.zh: 不，我想和他谈谈。

sentences.en: Don't talk to me.
sentences.zh: 别跟我说话。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: But tell me I'm standing right here in front of you.
sentences.zh: 但告诉我，我就站在你面前。

sentences.en: I think I looked at him.
sentences.zh: 我想我看着他了。

sentences.en: What do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有什么？

sentences.en: Do you think that he's telling the truth?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他说的是实话吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Do you think that he's telling the truth to the country?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他对国家说的是实话吗？

sentences.en: You have power when so many women are powerless.
sentences.zh: 在这么多女性无权无势的时候，你拥有权力。

sentences.en: I looked at him.
sentences.zh: 我看着他。

sentences.en: We looked at him.
sentences.zh: 我们看着他。

sentences.en: We looked at his face.
sentences.zh: 我们看着他的脸。

sentences.en: The same way that we were demanding that he look at us, we were looking at him.
sentences.zh: 就像我们要求他看着我们一样，我们在看着他。

sentences.en: I could see that the turmoil of the last few weeks really in him, and I could see turmoil in his face.
sentences.zh: 我能看出过去几周的动荡真的留在他身上，我能看到他脸上的动荡。

sentences.en: Senator, do you want to respond to their complaints?
sentences.zh: 参议员，你想回应他们的抱怨吗？

sentences.en: Senator, do you care to respond to their complaints?
sentences.zh: 参议员，您想回应他们的抱怨吗？

sentences.en: No, I need to go to the hearing.
sentences.zh: 不，我得去听证会了。

sentences.en: I just issued a statement.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚发表了一份声明。

sentences.en: I'll be saying more as well.
sentences.zh: 我也会说更多的话。

sentences.en: So, no, there have been a lot of questions here.
sentences.zh: 所以，没有，这里有很多问题。

sentences.en: Not in my wildest dreams did I actually think he was going to take a different action from the action he had already announced.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没想到他会采取与他已经宣布的行动不同的行动。

sentences.en: Poppy, I don't think we've witnessed a moment like that in recent memory.
sentences.zh: 波比，我认为我们最近没有见过这样的时刻。

sentences.en: A U.S.
sentences.zh: 一名美国

sentences.en: senator confronted by two, I believe, women who say that they have been raped themselves.
sentences.zh: 参议员遭到两名我认为自称遭到强奸的女性的质问。

sentences.en: One of them saying to him, and I'm quoting here through tears, don't look away from me.
sentences.zh: 其中一人含着泪对他说，这里我引用一下，不要把视线从我身上移开。

sentences.en: Look at me and tell me that it doesn't matter what happens to me.
sentences.zh: 看着我，告诉我发生在我身上的事不重要。

sentences.en: It's just remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: It is remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这确实不寻常。

sentences.en: We just witnessed about five minutes of Republican Senator Ford...
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚目睹了大约五分钟的共和党参议员福特……

sentences.en: I wonder what you make of the fact that you may have gotten through to Senator Flake.
sentences.zh: 我想你对你可能已经说动了弗莱克参议员这件事有什么看法？

sentences.en: He may have left open some space in his heart and in his mind to be influenced by the perspective
sentences.zh: 他可能在他的内心和思想中留出了一些空间，以受到周围人观点的影响

sentences.en: of those around him, not just his close aides, but in a sense by complete strangers.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是他的亲信，在某种意义上还有素不相识的人。

sentences.en: But one of the reasons that he's leaving office is because he's so troubled by the state of
sentences.zh: 但他离职的原因之一是他对华盛顿的党派之争状态感到非常不安

sentences.en: partisanship in Washington and without Flake in office, there wouldn't have been a single person on that committee who would have been actually open to changing their mind.
sentences.zh: 如果没有弗莱克在任，委员会里就不会有任何人真正愿意改变他们的想法。

sentences.en: I feel worried, like Senator Flake feels worried about the state of our politics.
sentences.zh: 我感到担忧，就像弗莱克参议员对我们的政治现状感到担忧一样。

sentences.en: And I think it is by forcing those who are elected to remember that they are not representing their party.
sentences.zh: 我认为，正是通过迫使当选者记住他们并不代表他们的政党。

sentences.en: They are representing people who have stories and experiences, whose lives are shaped every day by their decisions.
sentences.zh: 他们代表的是那些有着故事和经历的人，他们的生活每天都被他们的决定所塑造。

sentences.en: That that is the role that they should be playing.
sentences.zh: 这才是他们应该扮演的角色。

sentences.en: That when they make decisions, they have to be thinking about how it impacts real humans.
sentences.zh: 当他们做出决定时，他们必须考虑这会如何影响真实的人类。

sentences.en: Listen, Ta-Nehisi Coates' book to his son, Between the World and Me, has one sentence that I feel like is so important.
sentences.zh: 听着，塔-内西·科茨写给儿子的书《世界与我之间》中有一句话，我觉得非常重要。

sentences.en: He says, we cannot understand slavery or any great injustice by thinking about the masses.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们不能通过考虑大众来理解奴役或任何巨大的不公。

sentences.en: We have to think about it in the experience of one person.
sentences.zh: 我们必须从一个人的经历来思考它。

sentences.en: Listen, what was this enslaved woman thinking when she woke up in the morning?
sentences.zh: 听着，这个被奴役的女性早晨醒来时在想什么？

sentences.en: Who did she miss that morning?
sentences.zh: 那天早上她想念谁？

sentences.en: Who did she talk to when she felt sad?
sentences.zh: 当她感到悲伤时，她和谁说话？

sentences.en: How did she feel when her child was stolen from her?
sentences.zh: 当她的孩子被从她身边夺走时，她是什么感觉？

sentences.en: We have to think about, and especially people who are in the position of creating laws in our
sentences.zh: 我们必须思考，特别是那些处于在我们国家制定法律地位的人

sentences.en: country, have to think about the impact of their decisions by thinking about one person.
sentences.zh: 必须通过考虑一个人来思考他们决定的影响。

sentences.en: How is that one person going to be shaped by me?
sentences.zh: 这个人将如何被我塑造？

sentences.en: And I think Senator Flake has a sense of that and was forced to remember that when Maria and I confronted him in the elevator.
sentences.zh: 我想弗莱克参议员对这一点有所感悟，当玛丽亚和我 S 在电梯里质问他时，他被迫想起了这一点。

sentences.en: And now that you've had a little more time to think about it, is there anything else that you want to say to Senator Flake?
sentences.zh: 现在你有了更多时间来思考，你还有什么想对弗莱克参议员说的吗？

sentences.en: Um, I want to make sure that he knows that we will not forget, he knows this, but I want to, if I could talk to him again, I would tell him, we won't forget,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想确保他知道我们不会忘记，他知道这一点，但我想，如果我能再次和他对话，我会告诉他，我们不会忘记，

sentences.en: women will remember
sentences.zh: 女性会记住

sentences.en: what you're doing, and we will draw meaning from your actions for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 你正在做的事，我们将在许多年里从你的行动中汲取意义。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for spending time with us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您花时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他事情。

sentences.en: A 7.5 magnitude earthquake that struck Indonesia on Friday triggered a deadly tsunami that has killed at least 830 people and possibly hundreds more.
sentences.zh: 周五袭击印尼的7.5级地震引发了致命海啸，已造成至少830人死亡，可能还有数百人遇难。

sentences.en: The death toll has quickly led to questions about Indonesia's early warning systems, especially
sentences.zh: 死亡人数迅速引发了对印尼预警系统的质疑

sentences.en: after officials told The Times that none of the 22 buoys that the country uses to monitor for tsunamis, have been operational in years.
sentences.zh: 此前官员告诉《泰晤士报》，该国用于监测海啸的22个浮标中，没有一个在过去几年里投入使用。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了群自称改革派的人时。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈的、混乱的、有时甚至是惊心动魄的
